answer.reason: StayStatus maps one to one onto RhReservationStatus (HELD->Held, CONF->Conf, NOSHOW->NoShow, CXL->Cxl, CXL_LATE->CxlLate) and keeps the vendor's own abbreviations. The glossary never names these statuses, so it gives no sign the domain owns them, even though settle-stay branches on every member.
